objectives.name: Minimal, bounded, universal sufficient statistic
objectives.metric: T0 PASS iff every T1-T4 objective PASSes
objectives.gate: all foundation + certificate + consumer + invariant objectives PASS
objectives.scope: Per-stream: E is trained on THIS stream and never cross-applied. Coverage is over functions of the OBSERVED stream at FIXED capacity; unlogged confounders are uncertainty. 'Any stream' = any stream conforming to the canonical 4-column interface. 'All plugins' = by-construction coverage for unknown consumers PLUS realized superiority on the frozen supervised/unsupervised/decision battery. Sufficiency is certified for the DECLARED future family; the U power controls attribute it to the exhaustive measure block (shape-only U reported). Full-E value geometry is reported, not gated (the accessible measure block is the value view).

objectives.name: Schema-universal ingestion
objectives.metric: any canonical 4-column stream, including degenerate schemas
objectives.gate: adversarial schema suite runs or rejects loudly

objectives.name: Frozen / reusable donor
objectives.metric: downstream reads E; encoder never mutated

objectives.name: Transfer above traditional
objectives.metric: adds over traditional on >=1 consumer head (supervised or unsupervised); hurts none
objectives.gate: E >= traditional on >=1 held-out head and no FAIL (paired CI)
objectives.current: supervised: 0 add / 5 NO_SIGNAL / 0 fail; unsupervised segmentation: PASS
objectives.evidence: supervised: 0 add / 5 NO_SIGNAL / 0 fail; unsupervised segmentation: PASS

objectives.name: Shared geometry
objectives.metric: isotropy / effective rank of consumed E

objectives.name: Sufficiency certificate
objectives.metric: excess loss vs independent sequence oracle + power controls
objectives.gate: U SOLVED at fixed capacity; measure/shape/destroyed controls reported

objectives.name: Minimality certificate
objectives.metric: block-wise shape + explicit measure (joint min recorded)
objectives.evidence: block-wise served certificate (shape rank + explicit measure)

objectives.name: Decision-sufficiency
objectives.metric: response-block policy evaluated on realized FUTURE outcomes; DiD null
objectives.gate: DEPLOY with real_lo - null_hi > 0; matching null HOLD
objectives.evidence: every real DEPLOY matched by a null HOLD

objectives.name: Supervised gate
objectives.metric: held-out heads (valid classes; degenerate targets excluded)
objectives.gate: no significant regression + >=1 WIN vs fair generic (same head)
objectives.current: 2 WIN / 3 tie (measure-carried) / 0 regression vs fair generic (no significant regression + wins where the shape adds)
objectives.evidence: 2 WIN / 3 tie (measure-carried) / 0 regression vs fair generic (no significant regression + wins where the shape adds)

objectives.name: Unsupervised gate
objectives.gate: measure block >= generic; full-concat reported; silhouette reported
objectives.control: fair generic measure k-means (accessible measure block)
objectives.baseline: fair generic measure k-means (accessible measure block)

objectives.evidence: value differentiation eta2=0.239 vs 0.239, ANOVA F=1883.7282 vs 1883.7282, lookalike 3.795 vs 3.795; silhouette 0.367 vs 0.367 (compactness, reported)

objectives.name: Decision/OPE gate
objectives.metric: coverage / false deploys / precision / recall / rank
objectives.gate: E-policy >= logging policy and model-free DR; acceptance PASS
objectives.evidence: explicit fleet verdict vs logging policy + model-free DR

objectives.name: Reproducibility
objectives.gate: same config/seed -> same embedding hash + identity receipt

objectives.name: Honest gates
objectives.metric: null controls; never weaken a gate
